attributes.action: McGills Buses, Midland Bluebird and XPLORE Dundee Shutdown.
attributes.additional_details:
Their lack of support to drivers are appalling, I got told they treat their drivers like filth and to top it off, they have been recently agitated, giving disrespect to passengers on the bus.

2 of their Enviro 200's have caught fire recently, which shows that they cannot maintain and check their buses.

They put a bus which can possibly explode because of a broken belt still on route on public services, the interior is disgusting.
attributes.background: McGills cannot maintain their buses, they have been causing mass delays, Cancellations, their lack of support, they can't maintain their buses and angry drivers. They are been called a bio hazard according to the public, 2 buses caught fire in 1 day. They need to go.
